definitions.explanation: Products harvested from the sea, including fish, shellfish, seaweed, and other marine organisms. A somewhat formal term encompassing all ocean-derived food and materials.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}は{海産物|かいさんぶつ}が{豊富|ほうふ}だ。
examples.english: Hokkaido is rich in marine products.

examples.japanese: {市場|いちば}で{新鮮|しんせん}な{海産物|かいさんぶつ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought fresh seafood at the market.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{海産物|かいさんぶつ}の{加工|かこう}{産業|さんぎょう}で{栄|さか}えてきた。
examples.english: This region has prospered through its marine product processing industry.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal compound noun. In everyday conversation, {魚介類|ぎょかいるい} (seafood, fish and shellfish) or simply {海|うみ}の{幸|さち} (bounty of the sea) are also used. {海産物|かいさんぶつ} is broader, encompassing seaweed and other non-fish/shellfish items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新鮮|しんせん}な{海産物|かいさんぶつ}: fresh marine products
- {海産物|かいさんぶつ}の{加工|かこう}: processing of marine products
- {海産物|かいさんぶつ}{市場|いちば}: seafood market
